text:
incident-bot: ALERT: P2 - sustained 5xx spike and enqueue growth on dedicated-us-west-1 pool. ~18% 5xx over last 5m, avg queue depth +120. Potential customer impact: corpA, corpB. Incident created: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-1987 :rotating_light:

Marta (oncall): I'm on it, taking page. beginning triage — will coordinate mitigations here.

Diego R: seeing autoscaler stuck at max_replicas=40 but pods are saturating (GPU util ~95%). Looks like burst toggle was defaulted off for this pool.

Sasha: spike source = corpA batch jobs (long-context, seq_len 16k) + some retry storms from an integration.

Marta (oncall): immediate plan:
1) enable burst capacity on dedicated-us-west-1 to give headroom
2) bump autoscaler max_replicas to 60 temporarily
3) apply per-customer rate-limit for corpA to 10 rps and reduce max_seq_len to 8k for them
4) if needed, disable long-context route for corpA only

Kim: I can flip toggles. Pushing change now.

deploy-bot: @Kim requested pool toggle change. Runbook requires posting command+ID.

Kim: executing:
```bash
# enable burst capacity for pool
curl -sS -X POST "https://api.redwood.internal/pools/dedicated-us-west-1/toggles" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"enable_burst": true, "burst_capacity": 20, "note": "live mitigation - high 5xx"}'
```

ops-bot: ACTION LOGGED: toggle_enable_burst | pool=dedicated-us-west-1 | by=Kim | ts=1912345712

Lee: bumping autoscaler max_replicas -> 60 via console, will also set scale_cooldown=30s for faster reaction.

Diego R: making routing change to throttle corpA requests:
```http
PATCH /routing/policies/mitigations
Host: controlplane.redwood
Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN
Content-Type: application/json

{ "match": {"customer_id": "corpA"}, "throttle_rps": 10, "max_seq_len": 8000, "comment": "mitigation - autoscale lag" }
```

Sasha: pushed a canary for the throttle, 10% of corpA traffic first. Monitoring behavior.

Marta (oncall): good. also create a temporary quota override: corpA monthly_quota -= 30% to reduce background jobs during surge. Kim, can you apply?

Kim: applied quota delta via billing API (delta_id=mit-1912345738). ops-bot logged.

ops-bot: ACTION LOGGED: quota_override | customer=corpA | delta=-30% | by=Kim | ts=1912345740

Marta (oncall): if 5xx doesn't drop in 5m after burst/scale, disable experimental route 'long-context-v2' for corpA only. Prepared command below.

Sasha: disabling route now for corpA (canary then 100%).
```bash
redwoodctl routes set --route long-context-v2 --customer corpA --disabled true --reason "live mitigation - reduce seq_len pressure"
```

deploy-bot: ROUTE CHANGE APPLIED (canary)-> id=rc-1912345752

Diego R: ~90s after enabling burst and increasing max_replicas: GPU util dropped from 95% -> 45%, queue depth down to +12, 5xx down to ~2.5%. Nice.

Marta (oncall): excellent. keep burst enabled for 30m while traffic normalizes. Kim, leave autoscaler max_replicas at 60 for now but mark for rollback in 30m.

Kim: ack. setting timer/ephemeral note in runbook. I also adjusted scale_in_min_replicas to 10 to avoid thrash.

Lee: added temporary alert suppression for false positives on this pool so alert noise doesn't page extraneous folks while we're in mitigation (suppress until 1912347520).

Marta (oncall): customer comms note: corpA impacted by throttling and route disable; corpB saw degraded latency but no throttles. I'll draft a short status update to CSM.

Sasha: monitoring logs: a bunch of retries from upstream integration caused amplification. Recommend contacting corpA SRE to ask them to stop aggressive retries.

Diego R: notes for rollback:
- disable burst: curl -XPOST /pools/... {"enable_burst": false}
- reset autoscaler max_replicas to 40
- remove corpA throttle rule
- re-enable long-context-v2 for corpA
(do these in the indicated order to avoid sudden pressure)

Marta (oncall): leaving on-call to Kim at 10:30 UTC handoff. Handoff notes: actions taken, observed improvements, rollback steps above, runbook refs: RB-POOL-BURST, RB-CUSTOMER-THROTTLE.

Kim: taking handoff. I will keep the mitigation in place for the next 30m and re-evaluate. If metrics stable for 20m, we'll scale down burst and revert max_replicas to 45 as a gradual rollback.

ops-bot: HANDOFF: from=Marta | to=Kim | at=1912345860 | note="Leaving mitigation enabled; watch queue/5xx"

Marta (oncall): thanks team. I'll update INC-2026-1987 with timeline and next steps.

Kim: ACK :thumbsup: will update status and notify CSM after 15m check.

deploy-bot: NOTE: all mitigation APIs used require post-mortem entry in incident ticket.

Lee: final check at ts=1912345918 - 5xx=1.9%, avg latency +tail = down to baseline.

Marta (oncall): closing immediate pager; incident remains open for followup and RCA.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status=mitigated | mitigations=burst_enabled, autoscaler_max=60, corpA_throttle | next_action=reassess-30m | incident_link=https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-1987
